# telnyx_bundle_pricing_billing_bundle (Data Source)

A billing bundle Telnyx offers.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_id` (String) The bundle.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) If that bundle is active or not.
- `bundle_limits` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bundle_limits))
- `cost_code` (String) Bundle's cost code, this is used to identify the bundle in the billing system.
- `created_at` (String) Date the bundle was created.
- `id` (String) Bundle's ID, this is used to identify the bundle in the API.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Available to all customers or only to specific customers.
- `name` (String) Bundle's name, this is used to identify the bundle in the UI.
- `slug` (String) Slugified version of the bundle's name.

<a id="nestedatt--bundle_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bundle_limits`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Use country_iso instead

- `direction` (String) An enumeration.
- `id` (String)
- `limit` (Number)
- `metric` (String)
- `rate` (String)
- `service` (String)
